column1: #place label(configured_stockpiles) start(1; 1) message(Two configured food piles; a booze pile with extra barrels on the left; a barrel-free seed pile on the right so the seeds do not spoil.)
title: Configured food stockpiles (booze and seeds)
tags: stockpile, place, config, brewing, seeds, starter
description: Two named and filtered food stockpiles that show the DFHack quickfort stockpile-config tokens. The left 2x3 pile is named Drinks
column3: and is set to hold only booze (:=booze). The right 2x3 pile is named Seeds and set to hold only seeds (:=seeds) with barrels=0
column4: the standard trick that keeps seeds out of barrels so they do not spoil. A one-tile gap between them keeps the two piles separate. Both use the {name ... container} property block plus a :config preset
column5: so painting them shows how per-type filtering and container counts attach to a stockpile.
